description:
Are you looking for an Office Document Reader that can open all the Office documents on your phone? Document Viewer - All Document Reader is a complete package that helps you view all types of documents, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, and text files.

Read all type of documents with ease!

Office Document Reader, Excel Viewer, PPT Viewer, PDF Reader, Rar, Zip & Docx Reader

Office Document Reader - Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF & More!

By using the Office Document Reader application, you can view all the documents under one roof. You don't need to install multiple applications to open apps on different platforms. It is a simple, fast, and lightweight file viewer that is specially designed for people who want to view and edit their documents in one application. This application allows users to manage their documents as well. The file opening process is quick, and its interactive layout makes this application interesting and easy to use. Edit PDF, Excel and Word documents easily! Office Document Reader has the following features: • Easy file viewer for Word files with document viewer (doc/Docx) • Excel file viewer and Office Document reader (Xls/xlsx) • PowerPoint viewer and Document editor (ppt/pptx) • Text file reader (.txt) • A PDF reader • Support ZIP and RAR files Office Document Reader app is the one and only file viewer you'll ever need. Additional features of Office Reader All in One App: • It can open documents with different platforms without the internet. • Small size. • The processing time with Document Reader is fast. • Able to share files with different apps. • File viewer - manage documents and create in-app folders • Easy to search documents from the internal as well as external memory. Special features of Document Reader Manage Word, Excel, PDF, PowerPoint, and other files easily! The Office Document Reader app feature will help manage and arrange the files into different folders. Advanced synchronization can integrate with the file manager as per the permission granted by the users. PDF Viewer and document editor in one app. Office Document Reader is a simple and user-friendly application that is available for all smartphones. File Viewer Document viewer / Document reader for Android lets you easily view Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Text, and PDF files. It also supports multiple compatibilities with office formats, including DOC, DOCX, XLSX, TXT, PPT, PPTX, and PDF Reader. PDF Reader & PDF Converter Convert and read PDF files in the most convenient way. With our pdf reader, you can easily open pdf files with elementary operations. Image to PDF Converter can convert images to PDF files instantly. Import images or scan paper files with your camera and convert them to PDFs - notes, receipts, invoices, forms, business cards, certificates, whiteboards, ID cards, etc., all supported. Excel file reader Office Document Reader is the best excel and .xls file reader. With our Excel File Reader feature, you can view and read your business .xlsx reports on your android phone.
